title: Error when creating a functional index with columns after function expressions
body:
When creating a functional index, an error occurs if there are any non-functional expressions found after a function. Using SQLAlchemy 1.3.6.

Sample code:

```python
from sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, Column, Integer, String, Index, func

engine = create_engine('sqlite:///:memory:', echo=True)
Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'users'
    __table_args__ = (Index('users_idx', func.lower('name'), 'value'),)

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    name = Column(String)
    value = Column(String)

Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
```

Throws an error:

```Traceback (most recent call last):

    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
  File "/home/jmabey/Code/bug/env/lib/python3.7/site-packages/sqlalchemy/sql/schema.py", line 4287, in create_all
    ddl.SchemaGenerator, self, checkfirst=checkfirst, tables=tables

    conn._run_visitor(visitorcallable, element, **kwargs)
  File "/home/jmabey/Code/bug/env/lib/python3.7/site-packages/sqlalchemy/engine/base.py", line 1607, in _run_visitor

    return meth(obj, **kw)

    _is_metadata_operation=True,

    return meth(obj, **kw)
  File "/home/jmabey/Code/bug/env/lib/python3.7/site-packages/sqlalchemy/sql/ddl.py", line 833, in visit_table
    self.traverse_single(index)
  File "/home/jmabey/Code/bug/env/lib/python3.7/site-packages/sqlalchemy/sql/visitors.py", line 131, in traverse_single
    return meth(obj, **kw)
  File "/home/jmabey/Code/bug/env/lib/python3.7/site-packages/sqlalchemy/sql/ddl.py", line 862, in visit_index
    self.connection.execute(CreateIndex(index))

    return dialect.ddl_compiler(dialect, self, **kw)

    return obj._compiler_dispatch(self, **kwargs)
  File "/home/jmabey/Code/bug/env/lib/python3.7/site-packages/sqlalchemy/sql/visitors.py", line 91, in _compiler_dispatch
    return meth(self, **kw)
  File "/home/jmabey/Code/bug/env/lib/python3.7/site-packages/sqlalchemy/dialects/sqlite/base.py", line 1191, in visit_create_index
    for expr in index.expressions
  File "/home/jmabey/Code/bug/env/lib/python3.7/site-packages/sqlalchemy/dialects/sqlite/base.py", line 1191, in <genexpr>
    for expr in index.expressions
  File "/home/jmabey/Code/bug/env/lib/python3.7/site-packages/sqlalchemy/sql/compiler.py", line 350, in process
    return obj._compiler_dispatch(self, **kwargs)
AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute '_compiler_dispatch'
```

If I reorder the index to `Index('users_idx', 'value', func.lower('name'))`, then it works fine.
